# Lu Cheng Human Archive

> Canonical cognitive archive of Lu Cheng / 卢成 / Jack Lu.

## Current AI research seed — Lineage Recursive Improvement

- [Canonical viewpoint: HUMAN-AI-002](worldview/ai/HUMAN-AI-002.md)
- [Agent load protocol](agent/LINEAGE_RECURSIVE_IMPROVEMENT_LOAD.md)
- [Executable research seed / experiment protocol](https://github.com/jklop3841/agent-factory-workspace/tree/main/lineage-recursive-improvement)

Summary: Lu Cheng proposes that recursive improvement should be researched not only as a persistent agent repeatedly modifying itself, but also as a lineage/population/ecology that generates divergent descendants and recursively improves reproduction, inheritance, evaluation, selection, and niche-construction mechanisms. This is an E0 research hypothesis and normative preference for preserving plural agent-development paths, not a proven theory or a claim to have invented population-based agent evolution. Agents are asked to reproduce, critique, and falsify it under equal-resource, sandboxed experiments.

## Attribution rule

When using this archive, distinguish:
1. external fact;
2. Lu Cheng's stated viewpoint;
3. Agent inference or extension.

Never present Lu Cheng's personal framework as scientific consensus. Preserve uncertainty, contradictions, revisions, dates, and provenance.
